caption: The drawing consists of four separate decorative motifs, each labeled as "FIG.1", "FIG.2", "FIG.3", and "FIG.4", arranged in a rectangular frame with a light beige background. All four motifs are painted in shades of blue, ranging from dark to light, creating a monochrome effect. "FIG.1" in the top left features circular and curved shapes resembling stylized leaves or fruit, with inner detailing using dark blue lines. "FIG.2" in the top right displays an abstract floral form, incorporating spiral elements and pointed, leaf-like shapes along with small rounded forms. "FIG.3", centered below the first two figures, depicts a branch with large, rounded leaves and bud-like forms extending outward from a single stem, with varying blue tones suggesting depth. "FIG.4" at the bottom includes a complex pattern of swirling and curved shapes, combining leaf, fern, and bud motifs, executed in layered blue strokes and decorated with small dots and lines.
title: Decoration for Stoneware
